text: APPROVE. The `foreach` and its `continue` and ternary logic are moved into `RootItems` and `ToContainer`, which brings `Parse` well under 15. Evaluation order and the partial-results-on-`JsonException` behaviour are preserved, because `List.AddRange` over a lazy `IEnumerable` adds items one at a time, and nothing in the new code should trip warnings-as-errors. I reviewed the diff only and did not build it or run the tests.
